name: STL Decomposition
when_to_use: Time series to be diagnosed before choosing a model (ETS/ARIMA/Prophet); separate into trend, seasonality and residual in a way that is robust to outliers.
notes: Separates a time series into trend, seasonality and residual, visually and robustly to outliers. Applications: quick diagnosis before choosing among the already cataloged time-series models (12-suavizacao-exponencial-ets, 12-arima, 12-prophet).

expected_input.question: What are the trend, seasonality and residual of a time series?

pdca_use: Plan/Check phase: separate an indicator into trend, seasonality and residual before deciding whether a variation is a special cause or an expected seasonal pattern — closed-form decomposition, not a forecast.

plain_explanation.purpose: Separates a series into trend, seasonal cycle and remainder.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When you want to understand the series before forecasting, or remove seasonality.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A column of values over time, with regular period and at least 2 cycles.
plain_explanation.example: Separate the year-end rise from the real sales trend.
